contracts.evidence: Closed-Beta age>=16, email verification, onboarding/account gating, HttpOnly sessions, revocation and device-session management are merged in WellFit-now. Native and visual repos do not yet consume a migrated shared auth contract.
Server flow attempt->evidence->admin review->completion->ledger->wallet exists. Native mission/evidence event integration is not accepted end-to-end.

Server-authoritative internal ledger/wallet and Buddy spend exist with replay/idempotency/audit protections. WFXP versus WFP/XP semantics require explicit owner-reviewed migration; no token/real-money authority is active.

Server Buddy projections/actions for feed/care/play/clean/call/recovery exist. Unity project and bridge concepts exist physically in WellFit-now; migration to WellFit-Buddy and exact event schema acceptance remain open.

Worldwide published mission locations, geo-cell search, Haversine checks and safety-review fingerprints exist in WellFit-now. Native location/sensor evidence contract and real-device privacy validation are not accepted.

rules: Every cross-repository API, event, identifier or shared state must have a stable contract ID before acceptance.
Changing a contract requires impact review of all consumers.
Server-authoritative reward, mission and anti-cheat decisions remain outside the native client.
A contract may be centralized before source code is physically migrated during convergence.
PARTIAL means a real implementation exists but at least one consumer, migration, semantic decision or integration acceptance remains open.
